name: Polyhedron Moment Integration and Voxelization
aliases: R3D Polyhedron Moment Integration and Voxelization
definition: A method to compute polynomial density moments of a polyhedron within a voxel grid. It recursively splits a polyhedron along its longest axis until it occupies single voxels, then integrates the polynomial density field over the polyhedron volume for each resulting voxel.
summary: Polyhedron Moment Integration computes exact analytic density moments by recursively splitting polyhedra into voxels, differing from other methods by supporting arbitrary polynomial orders rather than binary occupancy or stochastic approximations.
